title: Asian Games: Janry Ubas books spot in long jump final

blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines—Team Philippines’ Janry Ubas advanced to the men’s long jump final of the Asian Games 2026 after hitting the qualification standard on his second attempt Sunday at Mizuho Park Stadium. The 32-year-old Ubas jumped 7.59 meters, good for eighth overall and enough to secure one of the 12 spots in Monday’s medal round. Uzbekistan’s Anvar Anvarov topped the qualifiers with an 8.00-meter effort. “I’m really happy because I hit the qualifying standard right away.
